claims.title: Hard-Constraint Route Gating

claims.nextProofRequired: Implement and test the same lane gate at the Worker entry contract before production use.

claims.title: SIMD-Accelerated Hamming Distance Kernels
claims.currentEvidence: No Wasm SIMD kernel is implemented in the current proof harness.
claims.nextProofRequired: Add a local Wasm SIMD distance kernel and benchmark it against the JS Hamming path.

claims.title: Matryoshka-Style Embedding Compaction
claims.currentEvidence: No nested short/full binary-token representation is implemented.
claims.nextProofRequired: Add a compact-vs-full retrieval probe that measures fast-path recall and reconstruction fidelity.

claims.title: Intra-Lane Local-Relationship Modeling
claims.currentEvidence: Current heads are routed specialists, not H-MHSA models.
claims.nextProofRequired: Build a controlled local/global relationship probe before changing model architecture.

claims.title: Explicit Lane-Ownership Policies
claims.currentEvidence: V27 route policy and V28 runtime policy contracts enforce local lane ownership.
claims.nextProofRequired: Promote the local policy to a Worker-entry contract only after deployment-specific tests exist.

claims.title: STE Gradient Fine-Tuning
claims.currentEvidence: V28 includes a controlled STE temperature-decay simulation only.
claims.nextProofRequired: Apply the temperature schedule to an actual training run and compare holdout drift.

claims.title: Zero-Copy Typed Array Buffering
claims.currentEvidence: No zero-copy JS-to-Wasm data path exists yet.
claims.nextProofRequired: Add a zero-copy TypedArray fixture and verify no serialization or buffer cloning is used.

claims.title: Durable Object Sharded State Coordination
claims.currentEvidence: V28 is local only and does not modify Cloudflare Durable Objects.
claims.nextProofRequired: Add a local DO-shard design proof, then a Worker integration test before deployment.

claims.title: QJL Error-Correction
claims.currentEvidence: No QJL checker or repair path is implemented.
claims.nextProofRequired: Create a QJL-only repair probe for quote, blind, and stress failures without changing V23/V27/V28 locks.

claims.title: Cold-Path Failure Fallback
claims.currentEvidence: V28 proves patch-local fallback in the local harness only.
claims.nextProofRequired: Connect fallback to a real high-precision path and prove sequence-level behavior on held-out failures.

claims.title: BART Preprocessing Pipeline
claims.currentEvidence: No BART dependency, command, or measured preprocessing probe exists in the repo.
claims.nextProofRequired: Run a controlled BART-vs-no-BART fingerprint test across quotes, legal text, code, and long-form passages.

claims.title: TokenTax0 Normalizer Pipeline
claims.currentEvidence: TokenTax0 is described in the report but not wired into this proof harness.
claims.nextProofRequired: Add a normalizer-only fixture and verify code/morphology preservation before 16xVS folding.

claims.title: Keepers vs Throwaways Memory Architecture
claims.currentEvidence: The repo has proof artifacts and snapshots, but not the described two-tier semantic memory runtime.
claims.nextProofRequired: Define a local memory schema and test keeper/throwaway routing without external systems.

claims.title: Data Growth Scaling Behavior
claims.currentEvidence: Current corpora are too small and controlled to prove asymptotic scaling behavior.
claims.nextProofRequired: Run a multi-size corpus sweep and show unique-fingerprint flattening, compression, and routing trends.

claims.title: Fold Mechanism
claims.currentEvidence: V18/V27 fold-lineage evidence supports parent-child retrieval shape in controlled fixtures.
claims.nextProofRequired: Prove unfolding quality on independent held-out content before claiming reversible reconstruction.

claims.title: Cognitive Stack
claims.currentEvidence: This is architecture strategy, not implemented in the local 16xVS proof harness.
claims.nextProofRequired: Define local interfaces before connecting 16xVS evidence to agent memory or orchestration layers.
